issues.on_page: Governmental activities - Health services; fund balance statement
issues.issue: Extractor treated the health department as governmental, though notes say the manifest lists it as 'hospital' (which the rules treat as entirely business-type). The statements are printed as governmental activities and a fund balance statement, so this looks right, but it is an assumption that departs from the manifest type.
Category is a judgment call (bank fees); already marked review. Amount is immaterial.
